documents.text: AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation Introduction Overview - AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation Skip to content AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation (c) AMWA 2023, CC Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-ND 4.0) Introduction AMWA BCP-002 is a series of recommendations for using Annotation Properties (see IS-13 ) to group, disambiguate and annotated NMOS resources. Getting started AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation - AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation Skip to content AMWA BCP-002: NMOS Resource Annotation What do the recommendations do? Document best practice and recommendations for how to use label , description and tags in AMWA NMOS APIs. Why do they matter? Provide a consistent way of referring to groups of related Resources (e.g. video and audio Senders of a camera) Provide a consistent way of distinguishing between Resources Provide a consistent way of annotating Resources with user information. What are the recommendations? BCP-002-01: Natural Grouping of NMOS Resources BCP-002-02: NMOS Asset Distinguishing Information Getting started Start with the recommendation relevant to the resource information being described: BCP-002-01 for grouping related Resources BCP-002-02 for human-readable distinguishing information for Resources There is more information about the NMOS Specifications and their GitHub repos at https://specs.amwa.tv/nmos .
